derived_method.JPL_fixed_width_conversion: Exact conversion of the JPL documented fixed-width epoch or angular notation to the stated physical unit; no astrometric correction is added.
derived_method.sexagesimal_conversion: Exact arithmetic conversion of complete sexagesimal source components to the stated unit.
derived_method.source_scalar: A source value already expressed as a scalar in its stated unit; exposed with separate unsigned magnitude and signed value.
derived_method.source_EDT_UTC_minus_4: Conversion of the source's explicitly stated Eastern Daylight Time, UTC minus four hours, to UTC by adding four hours.

derived_time_scale.UT_as_documented: Universal Time as labeled in the source. No unsupported choice between UT1 and UTC is imposed.
derived_time_scale.UT1: Universal Time based on Earth's rotation, explicitly identified as UT1 by the source.
derived_time_scale.UTC: Coordinated Universal Time, explicitly stated or obtained through the recorded time-zone conversion.
derived_time_scale.TT: Terrestrial Time explicitly specified by the source; not relabeled UT or UT1.
